definitions.explanation: A problem-solving method that involves trying various approaches and learning from mistakes.

notes:
{試行錯誤|しこうさくご} is a ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character compound) meaning trial and error — the process of trying different approaches and learning from mistakes until finding what works.

WRITING:
{試行|しこう} (trial, attempt) + ⟦{錯誤|さくご}→錯誤：27142_sakugo⟧ (error, mistake).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {試行錯誤|しこうさくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to repeat trial and error
- {試行錯誤|しこうさくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: as a result of trial and error
- {試行錯誤|しこうさくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: to accumulate trial and error (more literary)
- {試行錯誤|しこうさくご}し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: while going through trial and error

USAGE:
Common in business, research, cooking, creative work, and any context involving an iterative process. It carries a positive nuance — emphasizing perseverance and growth through experience rather than mere failure.
